the optimization of the stress distribution within a given solid body.
the design of microstructures for the purpose of optimizing the mechanical response of a solid, with the aim of minimizing stress concentration and, in turn improving its post elastic properties.

the development and application of novel computational tools for optimizing and toughen truss like structures, with the final purpose to design new microstructured materials, which might be employed in a wide range of engineering and biological applications.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the proposed optimization procedure, which is here introduced for the first time, is able to design and optimize the topology of micro structured truss like structures, with the purpose to maximize toughness and resilience of mechanical components.
, by following the proposed optimization strategy, it is possible to design and manufacture materials with unprecedented mechanical properties.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the proposed Galilei's stress optimization strategy might be a promising and powerful tool to conceive new materials with optimized mechanical performances, in particular to design structures with high overall toughness, which are of great interest in many fields, from aerospace and automotive industries to biomechanical engineering.

, by introducing the proposed Galilei's strategy, we have been able to optimize the design of a class of micro structured materials, with the goal of achieving a decrease of stress gradients and, in turn an increase of the overall resilience and toughness of the structure.

the proposed Galilei's approach to optimization is able to provide a rational framework for designing stress for optimizing and, in turn and most importantly, for toughening truss-like structures, including the ones with complex geometries, and, more in general, for designing materials with improved mechanical properties.
The main takeaway from our work is that

, in order to achieve a new class of toughened and resilient materials, the optimization procedure has to be performed by considering a proper stress measure, such as the von Mises stress, and not only a single scalar function, such as the elastic energy density.

, in the design of new micro structured materials, a stress-based optimization strategy, such as Galilei optimization, can provide a powerful tool to conceive new materials with improved mechanical properties.

the optimization procedure we propose might be used as a tool for designing and conceiving novel microstructured and hierarchically organized biomimetic materials with improved mechanical performance.
